corrections.proof: French original displays no z multiplying first term. Multiplying each fraction denominator byz yields the subsequently displayed II with external z^d, exactly as needed. The a_i=1 linear-section case also gives expected projective-space generating function.

By definition s(e(W1,W2)) projects to the even wedge summand; its complement is 1-e(W1,W2). XII1.12 gives e(W1)=fe,e(W2)=ef=1-fe when m=1. Thus printed e(W1,W2) and1-e(W2,W1) coincide and cannot split A⊕A. French scan confirms reversed printed order.

corrections.proof: At i=2n, XII3.3(ii) gives nonzero rank1 top cohomology forX, whileY has dimensionn-1 and its degree2n cohomology vanishes. The adjacent localization sequence gives top compact-supported rank1 exactly from this exception. French scan also omits2n.

SGA7-I ExposéIX §1 ends with Proposition1.5 before §2. XI Theorem1.6(i) in component013 gives R^if_*Z_l=0 for i odd !=n; for evenn take i=n-1, obtaining exactly(3.4.1). French scan really prints IX, hence a source typo.

XVIII5.2.2.1 expressly states smooth complete intersections satisfy(LV). XVIII5.2.5 instead assumes(LV) and concludes surjectivity of hyperplane restriction; it does not by itself establish the cited premise.

Current XXI§5.2 is in integrality appendix, not the general-section nonconiveau result. XXI Theorem4.2 gives H^{n-1}(X.H) !=N^1 for d>=n+1. Here d>2n andn=2m>=4, so N^{m-1}⊂N^1 and complete-intersection fixed partH^{n-1}(X)=0 byXI1.6(i); thus this theorem implies XX4.1.2.

corrections.reference_target_proof: Condition (B) (3.3.3)–(3.3.5) gives V m*=id only on H^{n-1}; consequently (id-m*V)^2=id-m*V and its kernel is Im m* on that degree. The argument next applies only to (4.4.11), whose target degree is 2m-1=n-1. No left inverse on all H* is assumed.

Definition (5.0.4) defines Grif as the integral quotient Z_{ell-coh}/Z_alg. The preceding source of the quotient arrow is Q tensor Z_{ell-coh}; its natural rationalized quotient is Grif tensor Q, which is precisely the group in (5.1.1) and the following proof sentence. A map from a rationalized group to the integral quotient has not been defined.

(5.0.6) expressly defines Prim_alg as the Q-subspace spanned by primitive algebraic cycle classes, so dim over Q_ell is undefined without changing that definition. XII 3.3–3.5 gives the two generator classes and rank-one primitive part of an even-dimensional smooth quadric; their rational span has Q-dimension one. Its extended Q_ell span also has dimension one, but is a different space.

corrections.exact_old_tex: 2.6. 若 $X$ 是 $\mathbb P^r$ 中维数为 $n$ 的完全交, 则由 (2.5.8) 立即可知, 只有当 $X$ 为奇数维二次超曲面时, $H^n(X)$ 的本原部分才为零.
corrections.exact_new_tex: 2.6. 若 $X$ 是 $\mathbb P^r$ 中维数为 $n$ 的完全交, 则由 (2.5.8) 立即可知, 只有当 $X$ 为奇数维二次超曲面时, $H^n(X)$ 的本原部分才为零.\EditorialFootnote{译校: 法文印本第 58 页的这句话还须排除 $X$ 本身为射影线性子空间的平凡情形. 此时由 2.4(i) 的 $H(1)=0$ (或 2.1 中 $d=0$ 的情形) 可知本原中间上同调同样为零. 删去次数为 $1$ 的方程后, 若仍有方程, 则这里列出的唯一情形确为奇数维二次超曲面.}

corrections.exact_old_tex: 在 XVIII~6.3.4 和 6.4 中已见, 次数为 $d>2n$ 的超曲面束满足假设 (4.1.1).
corrections.exact_new_tex: 在 XVIII~6.3.4 和 6.4 中已见, 次数为 $d>2n$ 的超曲面束满足假设 (4.1.1).\EditorialFootnote{译校: XVIII~6.4 本身只给出某个充分大次数界的存在性. 此处对完全交的显式充分条件可由 XI~1.6、2.6 和 XVIII~6.3.3 直接得到: $n$ 为偶数, 故 $H^{n-1}(X,\mathbb Q_\ell)=0$; 次数 $d>2n$ 的光滑截面仍为完全交, 且并非线性空间或奇数维二次超曲面, 因而其 $n-1$ 次上同调非零. 所以 XVIII~6.3.3 的限制映射不可能满射, 从而该 Lefschetz 线束满足 (A).}
corrections.reference_target_proof: XVIII6.4 only states existence of d_o, not d>2n. Under complete-intersection hypothesis, XI1.6(i) gives H^{n-1}(X)=0 since n even; XI2.6 plus its linear exception gives nonzero H^{n-1} for the smooth complete-intersection section with a degree-d equation d>2n. The restriction is not surjective. Since X satisfies LV, XVIII6.3.3(i)⇔(vi) proves A.
